sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: useIsMobile
sections.title: Mobile check hook
sections.what: Watches the window size, reports whether it is below the breakpoint, updates when it changes, and removes the watcher when the component goes away.
sections.why: Lets a component react to resizing without reloading the page.
sections.watch_out: The value is false until the setup step runs, so the mobile layout can appear late.

summary: A hook that reports whether the window is narrow, like a phone, and updates when the window is resized.
purpose: Lets a screen change its layout for small screens.
why: Likely reason: a common pattern for responsive layouts. The 768 pixel breakpoint is set in the code, but its reason is not stated.
how: Starts with an unknown value. When a component mounts, it sets up a watcher for widths below 768 pixels and reads the current width. On each change it updates the value. On unmount it removes the watcher. Returns false until the value is known.
outputs: true or false, for whether the window is mobile-sized.
risks: The first render returns false, so a mobile screen may briefly show the desktop layout before correcting.
debug: If the layout is wrong on phones, check the 768 value and that the browser reports the width correctly. If it does not update on resize, check the watcher.
